title: Production Pinflow: simplified version binding and performance timeline in Console
creator: Aisha Mathews
description: Deliver a streamlined Console surface for binding a service/route to a specific model version and publishing its performance profile timeline. This ticket covers UX flows for: selecting a candidate model version, pinning it for production traffic with canary controls, viewing past performance profiles and their metrics (latency P50/P95, token cost, failure rate), and publishing a performance snapshot to the model catalog for other teams. Goal: reduce cognitive load for platform and product teams when doing version rollouts and make perf trade-offs visible before committing.
acceptance_criteria: Console exposes a single-step 'Bind version' flow from the Service -> Version picker that lists compatible versions with key perf metrics
Users can configure a canary percentage and rollout duration inline (UI + default presets) and start rollouts without leaving the binding dialog
Performance timeline UI shows at least 30 days of P50/P95 latency, token cost per 1k tokens, error rate, and a per-version health badge
A 'Publish profile' action creates a performance snapshot that appears in the model catalog with metadata (dataset, eval prompt set, rollout context)
All interactions are covered by end-to-end tests and GA feature flags; telemetry events are emitted for pin/unpin/publish actions
comments: 2025-02-19 - Aisha Mathews: Kickoff with Eng (Riley) and Design (Marin). Confirmed scope: picker + bind dialog + perf timeline + publish action. Agreed to use existing perf metrics API (ENG-4217).

2025-02-24 - Riley Chen: Technical note - perf metrics API returns 90-day window aggregated at 1h granularity. We'll need client-side downsampling for the compact timeline. Estimated 3 engineering days for the chart component and 2 days to wire events and rollout backend hooks.

2025-02-27 - Marin Alvarez (Design): Uploaded mid-fidelity flows to Figma. Key UX decisions: inline canary presets (5%, 25%, 50%), 'quick compare' toggle to overlay two version timelines, and condensed perf badges in the version list.
2025-03-01 - QA (Samir Patel): Added test plan items for rollback behavior if canary exceeds error-rate threshold and for telemetry validation.
2025-03-03 - Riley Chen: Implemented backend endpoint to create/commit pin operations (PR: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4892). Needs a security pass for audit logging; filing ENG-4399.

2025-03-05 - Aisha Mathews: Product review - UX feels tight. Request to surface token-cost delta prominently when a newer version is ~10% cheaper but slightly higher P95. Added 'show delta' as follow-up task.
decision_log: Prefer single-modal binding flow over multi-step wizard to reduce drop-off (decision made 2025-02-19)
Default canary presets chosen to align with existing rollout policy (5/25/50) rather than custom first-run to simplify UI (2025-02-27)
Publish profile will attach a 'context blob' with dataset id and evaluation prompt set to improve traceability (2025-03-01)
Opted for client-side overlay compare vs server-side diff due to backend cost (2025-02-24)
Telemetry events standardized with analytics team: pin.started, pin.completed, pin.failed, profile.published (2025-03-03)
implementation_notes: Chart component will reuse Console's time-series primitives; implement downsampling and hover tooltips for token-cost metric
Version list rows show compact badges: health (green/yellow/red), P95 (ms), cost delta (%), last-published-profile timestamp
Backend must provide atomic commit endpoint for pin with canary args. Use optimistic lock to prevent concurrent pins on same service
Add feature flag 'console.pinflow.v1' for staged rollout to internal teams before org-wide GA
Ensure audit log entries include actor, IP, change payload, and user-supplied rollout note
